description: Produce two outputs: (1) SQLite database at /app/output/autotune.db conforming to /app/db_schema.sql, (2) JSON summary at /app/output/analysis.json as described below.

fields.total_valid_configs: integer: number of parameter combinations satisfying ALL kernel and hardware constraints
fields.max_occupancy_pct: float: highest theoretical SM occupancy percentage across all valid configs
fields.num_configs_at_max_occupancy: integer: count of valid configs achieving exactly max_occupancy_pct
fields.num_configs_above_50pct_occupancy: integer: count of valid configs with occupancy_pct strictly > 50.0

bottleneck_distribution.registers_only: integer: configs where only registers limit the resident block count per SM
bottleneck_distribution.smem_only: integer: configs where only shared memory limits the resident block count per SM
bottleneck_distribution.warps_only: integer: configs where only the warp limit constrains the resident block count per SM
bottleneck_distribution.multiple: integer: configs where two or more resources tie as the binding constraint

fields.occupancy_histogram: object mapping occupancy_pct values (as strings) to counts of configs at that occupancy level

specific_configs.label: string matching the query label
specific_configs.valid: boolean: whether all constraints are satisfied
specific_configs.smem_bytes: integer: shared memory data bytes (before any runtime overhead or alignment), or null if invalid
specific_configs.bottleneck: sorted list of strings from {'registers', 'smem', 'warps'}, or null if invalid
